_template_notes.purpose: Phase 9 structured output — per-scenario execution result với evidence paths + timing + auto-fix outcome. Cross-skill artifact consumed by Phase 10 (resolution input) + Phase 8 (E2E Summary aggregation) + integrity-impact.json v3 scenarios_artifacts[].
_template_notes.rendered_by: procedures/phase9-e2e-execute.md Step 9.6 (per scenario APPEND) + Step 9.10 (final aggregate)

schema_notes.lane_source: Constant 'CD41' — manifest đến từ CD41 lane
schema_notes.exec_mode: browser (default Playwright MCP) | api-only (HTTP request fallback khi fe-route-graph skipped)

scenarios[].execution_status: PASS | FAIL | AUTO_CORRECTED | QUARANTINED | BLOCKED | NOT_EXECUTED
scenarios[].duration_ms: Tổng thời gian execute (parse step + Playwright IO + verify expected)

evidence.evidence_complete: boolean — true nếu strict-evidence check pass

scenarios[].cross_module: boolean — true nếu scenario walk xuyên ≥2 modules (inherit từ manifest)
scenarios[].modules_visited[]: Modules thực sự navigate trong execution (subset của modules_involved)
scenarios[].failure_detail: Object hoặc null. Populated khi execution_status=FAIL: {step_num, expected, actual, error_message, failure_type_hint?}
scenarios[].auto_fix_attempts[]: Array các retry browser-fix trong Phase 9 (max 3): {attempt, strategy, outcome}
scenarios[].phase10_resolution_ref: string hoặc null — populated bởi Phase 10 với resolution ID

summary.phase9_duration_ms: Tổng wall-clock từ Step 9.1 đến Step 9.11
summary.stable_registry_hit_count: Số scenarios skip 5x pre-flight do hash match TTL <30d
